text_block_list.text:
—The summer grasses— all that remains of 
warriors' dreams.
I had... a dream.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I cannot wait around for the likes of you 
any longer!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I shall go ahead on my own. Farewell.
(Vrooooom...)

There it went. The bus heading to the 
summer training camp...

I was left behind, all alone... All... 
alone...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwahahaha, what a fool! To think you'd 
have such a ridiculous dream.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In fact, you made it in time just like 
this, didn't you?

Still, it was an eerily realistic dream. 
No Reason ended up going somewhere far 
beyond my reach...

We can no longer share our dreams 
together. From that point on, it was like 
tumbling down a slope...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, if it truly becomes too much of 
a burden, leaving it behind isn't out of 
the question, either."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The document issue with the Satsuki Sho. 
The portable shrine incident before the 
Japan Derby. It seems to me that thou art—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
She attracts outrageous troubles far too 
often.

Part of it was beyond our control. 
However, the reality is that it has 
genuinely caused worry and stress.

In order to avoid being handed a letter of 
divorce by No Reason—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho, giving it your all... you say?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll make up for my bad luck with 
hard work!

Yeah, I'll make up for my bad luck with 
sheer effort!

text_block_list.text:
Let us admit our lack of luck. And accept 
that this year is one of tribulations.

As long as you have the right mindset, you 
can overcome almost any hardship.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, that's the spirit! One who yields to 
the mischief of the heavens cannot be 
called my tactician.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I must laugh in the face of misfortune!

No one knows what might happen at the 
Kikuka Sho. Even so—I will overcome it.

It all came down to my own resolve and the 
bond I shared with No Reason.
